The updates one check finds can arrive in a single message, and OpenRouter summaries fall back past a busy free model and are kept between checks.

## ✨ Added

- **The updates one check finds can arrive in a single message.** Turn on One message per check under Settings → ShipLog → Notifications → Update notices, and ShipLog sends them together, the riskiest first. Unraid's notifications show them on one line. Thanks to @repires for the idea and the work ([#150](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/shiplog/issues/150)).
- **Lowest risk to announce holds back the message for an update below the risk you pick.** It still shows in the Docker tab, an update whose risk is unknown always goes out, and the message follows once a later check finds the update at the risk you picked.
- **A webhook or another channel that lists its events gets the grouped message as `update.batch`.** Add that event kind to it, or it keeps only the single update messages.
- **While TollRoll is your fortress's hub, the Update notices card says so.** TollRoll takes each update on its own and sends them its own way, and the lowest risk still applies.

## ⚡ Improved

- **OpenRouter falls back past a busy free model and keeps its summaries.** Several models separated by commas are tried in order, and a list of only free models ends with openrouter/free. A summary stays from one check to the next while the notes and the model stay the same, so a free model's daily allowance lasts. Thanks to @repires for the report and the fix ([#154](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/shiplog/issues/154)).
- **Picking a model from the list adds it to the models already in the field** instead of replacing them.

## 🌐 Translations

- **The new settings and the OpenRouter hint in all 26 languages,** with clearer wording for the update notices in Romanian, Chinese, Korean, Finnish, Hungarian, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian and Ukrainian.
